Elena Rostova
Senior Cybersecurity & Threat Intelligence Analyst
Washington, DC | elena.rostova@secmail.com | +1 202-555-0182 | linkedin.com/in/elenarostova-cyber

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Senior Cybersecurity Analyst with 6+ years of specialized experience in Security Operations Center (SOC) management, SIEM threat monitoring, incident response, and vulnerability management. Deep knowledge of NIST CSF, ISO 27001, MITRE ATT&CK framework, and advanced persistent threat (APT) detection. Proven track record of reducing mean time to detect (MTTD) by 70% and defending enterprise networks against ransomware and phishing attacks.

WORK EXPERIENCE
Senior Security Operations Analyst | CyberGuard Defense | Washington, DC | 2021 - Present
- Monitored and triaged 1,500+ daily security alerts using Splunk SIEM, Microsoft Sentinel, and CrowdStrike Falcon EDR across 12,000 corporate endpoints.
- Led incident response investigations for 45+ critical security events, containing active threats within an average of 18 minutes (70% MTTD reduction).
- Engineered 65+ custom Splunk correlation searches and detection rules mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK framework, decreasing false positive alarms by 55%.
- Conducted regular vulnerability assessments using Tenable Nessus and Qualys, prioritizing remediation for 400+ high and critical CVE vulnerabilities.
- Authored and maintained enterprise Incident Response Playbooks and conducted quarterly tabletop exercises for executive leadership.

Cybersecurity Analyst | SecureNet Financial | Reston, VA | 2018 - 2021
- Performed network traffic analysis and packet inspection using Wireshark, Snort, and Zeek, identifying and neutralizing 3 advanced malware campaigns.
- Managed multi-factor authentication (MFA) and Identity and Access Management (IAM) policies in Okta and Azure Active Directory for 3,500 employees.
- Executed simulated phishing campaigns and delivered cybersecurity awareness training, reducing employee click rates from 24% to 3.2%.
- Collaborated with internal audit teams to ensure strict adherence to PCI-DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2 Type II compliance standards.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Cybersecurity & Information Assurance | George Mason University | 2014 - 2018

TECHNICAL SKILLS
- SIEM & EDR: Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, CrowdStrike Falcon, Carbon Black, Elastic Security
- Vulnerability Management: Tenable Nessus, Qualys, Rapid7 InsightVM, Burp Suite
- Network & Traffic Analysis: Wireshark, Zeek, Snort, TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, Firewall Rules
- Frameworks & Compliance: NIST CSF, ISO 27001, MITRE ATT&CK, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, HIPAA
- Identity & Access: Okta, Azure Active Directory, IAM, MFA, SAML, Zero Trust Architecture
- Scripting & Automation: Python, PowerShell, Bash, SOAR (Cortex XSOAR)

CERTIFICATIONS
- Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) (2023)
- CompTIA Security+ (2019)
- GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) (2022)
jobDescriptionText:
Seeking a Senior Cybersecurity Analyst for our SOC team. Requirements:
- 5+ years experience in Security Operations (SOC), SIEM (Splunk/Sentinel), and Incident Response.
- Hands-on experience with EDR solutions (CrowdStrike), vulnerability scanners (Nessus/Qualys), and MITRE ATT&CK.
- Knowledge of compliance standards (NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2) and threat hunting.
- Security certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, or Security+ preferred.
